title: 27 Countries Enter, 14 Survive 🔥 Marble Survival Race · Heat 3/7
description:
Flagball Arena · Season 1, Round 1 · Heat 3/7: 27 countries race through 3 stages — only 14 survive and go to Round 2.

Countries in this heat: Algeria, Bolivia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Burkina Faso, Cape Verde, Central African Republic, Chile, Colombia, Congo, Czechia, DR Congo, Djibouti, Dominica, Ethiopia, Germany, Guinea-Bissau, Kyrgyzstan, Lesotho, Moldova, Nigeria, Paraguay, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, Samoa, Singapore, United Kingdom, Zambia.

Countries still in the game before this race: 163 of 193.
Next race: Round 1 · Heat 4/7. Grand Final: Nov 9.

How it works: all 193 countries race in heats → Round 2 → Semi-finals → Grand Final, then a new season starts. 3 new races every day.

Like 👍 if your country survived and write in the comments who you're cheering for!
